info.name: Certexi Sync
info.summary: Change feed and batch row writes for Nextcloud Tables, used by Certexi Home nodes
info.description:
Lets a Certexi Home node keep Nextcloud Tables in sync efficiently.
* A change journal records every row created, updated or deleted in Tables, so a node asks "what changed since N?" with one request instead of re-reading tables. * A batch endpoint applies many row creates, updates and deletes in one request and one database transaction.
Everything goes through the Tables app's own services, so a user can only read or change rows they already can in Tables. The journal stores row and table IDs only (no cell values) and is pruned after 30 days.
info.author: Certexi
